The '''R2-Delta upgrade''' was a software upgrade that was available to [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]]. In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], [[Catch]] received the Delta upgrade, which allowed him to make faster navigation computations.
